articles.title: Rubio condemns Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia in talks with Saudi foreign minister
articles.description: Eleven people were injured after one of the towers of the Financial Centre in Riyadh was targeted in an attack allegedly carried out by Yemen's Houthis.
